raw_arguments.content:
"""Render the LLMs in Medicine academic poster using Pillow.

A0 portrait at 150 DPI: 4967 x 7022 px.
Design philosophy: Clinical Rationalism.
Font sizes calibrated for A0 viewing at 3-8 feet:
  - Title: ~72pt (150px)
  - Section headers: ~40pt (83px)
  - Body: ~24pt (50px)
  - Metric values: ~60pt (125px)
  - Small/caption: ~16pt (33px)

Subtle reference: poster structure mirrors a clinical research paper —
Introduction (Overview) → Methods (Applications) → Results (Performance) →
Adverse Events (Risks) → Recommendations (Framework).
The amber risk metric functions like a flagged abnormal lab value.
"""

import math
import os
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Canvas (A0 portrait, 150 DPI) ──────────────────────────────────────────
DPI = 150
MM_TO_PX = DPI / 25.4
W = round(841 * MM_TO_PX)   # 4967
H = round(1189 * MM_TO_PX)  # 7022

# ── Color Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY      = (10, 22, 40)
WHITE     = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE = (246, 249, 252)
STEEL     = (74, 111, 165)
TEAL      = (44, 122, 140)
AMBER     = (212, 137, 42)
CORAL     = (224, 85, 74)
BODY_TEXT = (28, 28, 46)
LIGHT_TEXT = (90, 106, 126)
RULE_COLOR = (208, 213, 221)
CARD_BG   = (245, 247, 250)
CARD_BORDER = (218, 224, 232)

# ── Margins & Grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 200  # margin left
MR = 200  # margin right
MT = 180  # margin top
MB = 180  # margin bottom
CW = W - ML - MR          # content width: 4567
CH = H - MT - MB          # content height: 6662
COL_GAP = 80
COL_W = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2  # column width: 2243
LX = ML
RX = ML + COL_W + COL_GAP

# ── Font sizes (calibrated for A0 at 150 DPI) ──────────────────────────────
TITLE_SIZE   = 150  # ~72pt
SUB_SIZE     = 42   # ~20pt
SECTION_SIZE = 83   # ~40pt
BODY_SIZE    = 48   # ~23pt
BODY_SM      = 42   # ~20pt
SMALL_SIZE   = 34   # ~16pt
METRIC_VAL   = 120  # ~58pt
METRIC_LABEL = 36   # ~17pt
METRIC_CTX   = 28   # ~13pt
TABLE_HDR    = 34   # ~16pt
TABLE_CELL   = 30   # ~14pt
RISK_NUM     = 40   # ~19pt
RISK_TITLE   = 40   # ~19pt
RISK_DESC    = 34   # ~16pt
FRAMEWORK_NUM = 64  # ~31pt
FRAMEWORK_TITLE = 34 # ~16pt
FRAMEWORK_DESC = 28  # ~13pt
BENCH_LABEL  = 34   # ~16pt
BENCH_VAL    = 40   # ~19pt
CONF_SIZE    = 32   # ~15pt
FOOTER_SIZE  = 28   # ~13pt
REF_SIZE     = 30   # ~14pt

# ── Font Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def load_font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)


def get_size(draw, text, font):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1]


def wrap(draw, text, font, max_width):
    words = text.split()
    lines = []
    cur = []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur + [w])
        tw, _ = get_size(draw, test, font)
        if tw <= max_width:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur:
        lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines


def draw_lines(draw, lines, x, y, font, fill, ls=None):
    if ls is None:
        ls = font.size * 1.45
    cy = y
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, cy), line, font=font, fill=fill)
        cy += ls
    return cy


def rule(draw, x, y, w, color=RULE_COLOR, thickness=2):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + thickness], fill=color)


# ── Component Drawers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

def draw_title_block(draw):
    """Draw conference name, main title, subtitle, publication reference."""
    y = MT

    # Conference name
    cfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", CONF_SIZE)
    draw.text((ML, y), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024", font=cfont, fill=LIGHT_TEXT)
    y += 52

    # Main title — split into two lines for visual balance
    tfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TITLE_SIZE)
    line1 = "Large Language Models in Medicine:"
    line2 = "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward"
    draw.text((ML, y), line1, font=tfont, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SIZE + 30
    draw.text((ML, y), line2, font=tfont, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SIZE + 48

    # Subtitle
    sfont = load_font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", SUB_SIZE)
    sub = (
        "A comprehensive review of how large language models are transforming clinical practice, "
        "medical research, and healthcare delivery — along with the critical challenges that must be addressed."
    )
    sub_lines = wrap(draw, sub, sfont, CW - 60)
    y = draw_lines(draw, sub_lines, ML, y, sfont, LIGHT_TEXT, ls=SUB_SIZE * 1.55)
    y += 20

    # Publication reference
    rfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", REF_SIZE)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Published in Nature Medicine  ·  July 2023", font=rfont, fill=LIGHT_TEXT)
    y += 50

    # Thick rule
    rule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_COLOR, 3)
    y += 48

    return y


def draw_metric_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, context, accent_color=None):
    """Dashboard-style metric card with bold value and supporting text."""
    card_color = accent_color if accent_color else STEEL

    # Card background with subtle border
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [x, y, x + w, y + h],
        radius=16,
        fill=CARD_BG,
        outline=CARD_BORDER,
        width=2,
    )

    # Top accent bar
    bar_w = 72
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [x + 32, y + 32, x + 32 + bar_w, y + 38],
        radius=3,
        fill=card_color,
    )

    # Value — large, bold, the visual anchor
    vfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_VAL)
    draw.text((x + 32, y + 60), value, font=vfont, fill=card_color)

    # Label
    lfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_LABEL)
    label_lines = wrap(draw, label, lfont, w - 64)
    label_end = draw_lines(draw, label_lines, x + 32, y + 60 + METRIC_VAL + 24, lfont, BODY_TEXT, ls=METRIC_LABEL * 1.4)

    # Context (smaller, muted)
    cfont = load_font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", METRIC_CTX)
    ctx_lines = wrap(draw, context, cfont, w - 64)
    draw_lines(draw, ctx_lines, x + 32, label_end + 14, cfont, LIGHT_TEXT, ls=METRIC_CTX * 1.5)


def draw_metrics_row(draw, y):
    """4 metric cards spanning full content width."""
    gap = 36
    card_w = (CW - 3 * gap) // 4
    card_h = 520

    cards = [
        (">90%", "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded the passing threshold on all three steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination"),
        ("500+", "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Over 500 peer-reviewed publications on LLMs in medicine published in 2023 alone"),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "Studies report LLMs generate fabricated medical references or inaccurate clinical information in up to 30% of outputs"),
        ("$10.5B", "Global LLM Health Market",
         "The healthcare LLM market is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030"),
    ]

    for i, (val, label, ctx) in enumerate(cards):
        cx = ML + i * (card_w + gap)
        accent = AMBER if i == 2 else None
        draw_metric_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, label, ctx, accent)

    return y + card_h


def draw_section_header(draw, x, y, w, title, number=None):
    """Section header with optional numbered circle and rule beneath."""
    if number:
        r = 20
        nfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
        nstr = str(number)
        nw, nh = get_size(draw, nstr, nfont)
        draw.ellipse([x, y + 6, x + r * 2, y + 6 + r * 2], fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((x + r - nw // 2, y + 6 + r - nh // 2), nstr, font=nfont, fill=WHITE)
        tx = x + r * 2 + 22
    else:
        tx = x

    hfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", SECTION_SIZE)
    draw.text((tx, y), title, font=hfont, fill=NAVY)

    _, th = get_size(draw, title, hfont)
    ry = y + th + 18
    rule(draw, x, ry, w, RULE_COLOR, 2)
    return ry + 24


def draw_body_text(draw, x, y, w, text, font_size=BODY_SIZE):
    """Draw body paragraph with wrapping."""
    bfont = load_font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", font_size)
    lines = wrap(draw, text, bfont, w)
    return draw_lines(draw, lines, x, y, bfont, BODY_TEXT, ls=font_size * 1.55)


def draw_applications_table(draw, x, y, w):
    """Applications table with maturity indicators."""
    c1 = int(w * 0.38)
    c2 = int(w * 0.38)
    c3 = w - c1 - c2

    hfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TABLE_HDR)
    cfont = load_font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", TABLE_CELL)

    rows = [
        ("Clinical Documentation", "Automated notes, discharge summaries", "Pilot deployments"),
        ("Diagnostic Support", "Differential diagnosis, radiology reports", "Research stage"),
        ("Patient Communication", "Answering questions, simplifying jargon", "Early adoption"),
        ("Medical Education", "Exam prep, case-based learning, tutoring", "Active use"),
        ("Biomedical Research", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis gen.", "Emerging"),
    ]

    row_h = 70
    hdr_h = 56
    pad = 18

    # Header
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + hdr_h], fill=NAVY)
    draw.text((x + pad, y + 14), "Application Area", font=hfont, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x + c1 + pad, y + 14), "Example Use Cases", font=hfont, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x + c1 + c2 + pad, y + 14), "Maturity", font=hfont, fill=WHITE)

    cy = y + hdr_h
    for i, (area, use_cases, maturity) in enumerate(rows):
        bg = WHITE if i % 2 == 0 else OFF_WHITE
        draw.rectangle([x, cy, x + w, cy + row_h], fill=bg)
        rule(draw, x, cy, w, RULE_COLOR, 1)

        draw.text((x + pad, cy + 16), area, font=cfont, fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((x + c1 + pad, cy + 16), use_cases, font=cfont, fill=BODY_TEXT)

        mc = LIGHT_TEXT
        if maturity == "Active use":
            mc = TEAL
        elif maturity == "Pilot deployments":
            mc = STEEL
        draw.text((x + c1 + c2 + pad, cy + 16), maturity, font=cfont, fill=mc)

        cy += row_h

    rule(draw, x, cy, w, RULE_COLOR, 1)
    return cy + 20


def draw_risk_item(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Numbered risk item with coral accent circle."""
    nfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_NUM)
    tfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_TITLE)
    dfont = load_font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", RISK_DESC)

    # Number in coral circle
    r = 18
    nstr = str(number)
    nw, nh = get_size(draw, nstr, nfont)
    draw.ellipse([x, y + 2, x + r * 2, y + 2 + r * 2], fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((x + r - nw // 2, y + 2 + r - nh // 2), nstr, font=nfont, fill=WHITE)

    # Title
    draw.text((x + 52, y), title, font=tfont, fill=NAVY)

    # Description
    desc_lines = wrap(draw, description, dfont, w - 52)
    desc_y = y + RISK_TITLE + 12
    end_y = draw_lines(draw, desc_lines, x + 52, desc_y, dfont, BODY_TEXT, ls=RISK_DESC * 1.5)

    return end_y + 24


def draw_performance_bars(draw, x, y, w):
    """Horizontal bar chart for model benchmark scores."""
    lfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", BENCH_LABEL)
    vfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", BENCH_VAL)

    items = [
        ("GPT-4", ">90%", STEEL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", "86.5%", TEAL),
        ("GPT-3.5", "~60%", LIGHT_TEXT),
        ("Passing Threshold", "60%", RULE_COLOR),
    ]

    bar_total_w = w - 280
    row_h = 52
    cy = y + 16

    for model, score, color in items:
        draw.text((x, cy + 6), model, font=lfont, fill=BODY_TEXT)

        val = float(score.replace(">", "").replace("~", "").replace("%", ""))
        bar_w = int((val / 100) * bar_total_w)
        bar_x = x + 220

        if bar_w > 8:
            draw.rounded_rectangle(
                [bar_x, cy + 16, bar_x + bar_w, cy + 16 + 20],
                radius=4,
                fill=color,
            )
        draw.text((bar_x + bar_w + 16, cy + 6), score, font=vfont, fill=color)

        cy += row_h

    return cy + 8


def draw_framework_pillar(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Single framework pillar with large number, title, description."""
    nfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FRAMEWORK_NUM)
    tfont = load_font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FRAMEWORK_TITLE)
    dfont = load_font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", FRAMEWORK_DESC)

    # Large number
    draw.text((x, y), str(number), font=nfont, fill=TEAL)

    # Title
    tlines = wrap(draw, title, tfont, w)
    tend = draw_lines(draw, tlines, x, y + FRAMEWORK_NUM + 10, tfont, NAVY, ls=FRAMEWORK_TITLE * 1.35)

    # Description
    dlines = wrap(draw, description, dfont, w)
    dend = draw_lines(draw, dlines, x, tend + 10, dfont, LIGHT_TEXT, ls=FRAMEWORK_DESC * 1.5)

    return dend


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN RENDER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render():
    print(f"Creating A0 poster: {W}x{H} px at {DPI} DPI...")
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── 1. TITLE BLOCK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y = draw_title_block(draw)

    # ── 2. METRIC CARDS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y = draw_metrics_row(draw, y)
    y += 46
    rule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_COLOR, 2)
    y += 46

    # ── 3. TWO-COLUMN CONTENT ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    col_start = y

    # LEFT COLUMN: Overview → Applications → Performance
    ly = col_start
    ly = draw_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W, "What Are LLMs and Why Do They Matter for Medicine?", number=1)
    ly = draw_body_text(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have rapidly entered the "
        "healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in understanding and generating medical text. "
        "Trained on vast corpora of text data, these foundation models are poised to reshape clinical practice, "
        "biomedical research, and medical education. The pace of adoption has been extraordinary, with the "
        "global healthcare LLM market projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
    )
    ly += 36

    ly = draw_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W, "Key Clinical and Research Applications", number=2)
    ly = draw_body_text(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "LLMs are being explored across a wide spectrum of medical tasks, from clinical documentation "
        "to biomedical research. Clinical documentation and patient-facing communication tools have seen "
        "the fastest real-world adoption, with several health systems already integrating LLM-powered "
        "assistants into electronic health records.",
        font_size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ly += 20
    ly = draw_applications_table(draw, LX, ly, COL_W)
    ly += 36

    ly = draw_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W, "Performance Benchmarks and Evidence", number=3)
    ly = draw_body_text(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "LLM performance on standardized medical examinations has been a key evaluation domain. "
        "GPT-4 scored above 90% on all three steps of the USMLE, substantially exceeding the "
        "passing threshold of approximately 60%. Med-PaLM 2 achieved 86.5% on the MedQA benchmark, "
        "approaching expert physician-level performance. Earlier models such as GPT-3.5 scored near "
        "the passing threshold (~60%) but fell short on complex clinical reasoning.",
        font_size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ly += 20
    ly = draw_performance_bars(draw, LX, ly, COL_W)
    left_bottom = ly

    # RIGHT COLUMN: Risks — equal visual weight
    ry = col_start
    ry = draw_section_header(draw, RX, ry, COL_W, "Risks, Limitations, and Ethical Concerns", number=4)
    ry = draw_body_text(draw, RX, ry, COL_W,
        "Despite impressive benchmarks, significant concerns persist that must be "
        "acknowledged and addressed before widespread clinical deployment can be considered safe.",
        font_size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ry += 24

    risk_items = [
        (
            "Hallucinations and Fabrication",
            "LLMs can fabricate plausible-sounding but incorrect medical information, including fake "
            "citations and clinical guidelines. Studies report hallucination rates of up to 30% in "
            "medical question-answering tasks, making unverified outputs potentially dangerous."
        ),
        (
            "Bias and Health Equity",
            "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities "
            "in care recommendations across demographic groups. Without systematic auditing, these "
            "biases could worsen existing healthcare inequities."
        ),
        (
            "Patient Privacy",
            "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers operated by commercial "
            "entities, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns. The regulatory framework "
            "for LLM data handling in healthcare remains undeveloped."
        ),
        (
            "Lack of Clinical Validation",
            "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical "
            "trials or real-world outcome studies. This evidence gap between exam scores and bedside "
            "safety is the central challenge facing the field."
        ),
        (
            "Automation Bias and Over-Reliance",
            "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical "
            "appraisal. This risk is compounded by the models' tendency to present incorrect information "
            "with high confidence."
        ),
    ]

    for i, (rtitle, rdesc) in enumerate(risk_items, 1):
        ry = draw_risk_item(draw, RX, ry, COL_W, i, rtitle, rdesc)

    right_bottom = ry
    col_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom)
    y = col_bottom + 56

    # ── 4. FRAMEWORK SECTION (full width) ──────────────────────────────────
    band_top = y - 16

    # Draw light background band first, then content on top
    # Estimate band height
    band_h = 560
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [ML - 32, band_top, W - MR + 32, band_top + band_h],
        radius=20,
        fill=OFF_WHITE,
    )

    fy = band_top + 20
    fy = draw_section_header(draw, ML, fy, CW, "A Framework for Responsible Deployment", number=5)
    fy = draw_body_text(draw, ML, fy, CW,
        "The consensus from the Nature Medicine review is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential "
        "for medicine, but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust governance. "
        "The following five pillars constitute a multi-stakeholder framework for safe clinical integration.",
        font_size=BODY_SM,
    )
    fy += 32

    # Five pillars
    pillar_gap = 48
    pillar_w = (CW - 4 * pillar_gap) // 5
    px = ML

    pillars = [
        ("Rigorous Prospective\nEvaluation",
         "Validate in diverse clinical settings using prospective trials, not retrospective benchmarks alone."),
        ("Human-in-the-Loop\nDesign",
         "Ensure clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs. AI augments, never replaces, clinical judgment."),
        ("Transparent\nReporting",
         "Disclose model limitations, training data sources, and known failure modes to all stakeholders."),
        ("Equity\nAudits",
         "Assess differential performance across patient populations to prevent widening healthcare disparities."),
        ("Regulatory\nAlignment",
         "Align with evolving FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices and clinical decision support."),

arguments.content:
"""Render the LLMs in Medicine academic poster.

A0 portrait at 150 DPI: 4967 x 7022 px.
Design philosophy: Clinical Rationalism.

Refined typescale (physical → px at 150 DPI):
  Title: 72pt → 150px
  Section headers: 40pt → 83px
  Body: 23pt → 48px / 20pt → 42px
  Metric values: 58pt → 120px
  Small/caption: 16pt → 33px

Layout: poster mirrors a clinical research paper structure —
Introduction → Methods → Results → Adverse Events → Recommendations.
The amber risk metric functions like a flagged abnormal lab value.
"""

import os, math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT   = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Canvas (A0 portrait, 150 DPI) ──────────────────────────────────────────
DPI     = 150
MM2PX   = DPI / 25.4
W       = round(841 * MM2PX)   # 4967
H       = round(1189 * MM2PX)  # 7022

# ── Palette: Clinical Rationalism ──────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10, 22, 40)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE  = (246, 249, 252)
STEEL      = (74, 111, 165)
TEAL       = (44, 122, 140)
AMBER      = (212, 137, 42)
CORAL      = (224, 85, 74)
BODY       = (28, 28, 46)
MUTED      = (90, 106, 126)
RULE_CLR   = (208, 213, 221)
CARD_BG    = (245, 247, 250)
CARD_EDGE  = (218, 224, 232)

# ── Grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 200, 200       # margins left/right
MT, MB = 200, 200       # margins top/bottom
CW      = W - ML - MR   # 4567
CH      = H - MT - MB   # 6622
COL_GAP = 80
COL_W   = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2  # 2243
LX      = ML
RX      = ML + COL_W + COL_GAP

# ── Type scale (px) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TITLE_SZ    = 150
SUB_SZ      = 44
SEC_SZ      = 83
BODY_SZ     = 48
BODY_SM     = 42
SMALL_SZ    = 34
METRIC_VAL  = 120
METRIC_LBL  = 36
METRIC_CTX  = 28
TAB_HDR     = 34
TAB_CELL    = 30
RISK_NUM    = 40
RISK_TITLE  = 40
RISK_DESC   = 34
FW_NUM      = 64
FW_TITLE    = 34
FW_DESC     = 28
BENCH_LBL   = 34
BENCH_VAL   = 40
CONF_SZ     = 34
FOOTER_SZ   = 28
REF_SZ      = 30

# ── Font Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def text_size(draw, text, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0], b[3] - b[1]

def wrap_lines(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        trial = " ".join(cur + [w])
        if text_size(draw, trial, f)[0] <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur:
        lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def draw_text_block(draw, lines, x, y, f, fill, ls=None):
    if ls is None:
        ls = f.size * 1.5
    cy = y
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, cy), line, font=f, fill=fill)
        cy += ls
    return cy

def hrule(draw, x, y, w, color=RULE_CLR, thickness=2):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + thickness], fill=color)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMPONENTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render_title(draw):
    """Conference name, title, subtitle, source reference."""
    y = MT

    # Subtle top accent line
    draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, y - 8, ML + 120, y - 2], radius=3, fill=STEEL)
    y += 20

    # Conference
    cf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", CONF_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024", font=cf, fill=MUTED)
    y += 56

    # Title — two balanced lines
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TITLE_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Large Language Models in Medicine:", font=tf, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SZ + 32
    draw.text((ML, y), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=tf, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SZ + 52

    # Subtitle
    sf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", SUB_SZ)
    sub = (
        "A comprehensive review of how large language models are transforming clinical practice, "
        "medical research, and healthcare delivery — along with the critical challenges that must be addressed."
    )
    sub_lines = wrap_lines(draw, sub, sf, CW - 60)
    y = draw_text_block(draw, sub_lines, ML, y, sf, MUTED, ls=SUB_SZ * 1.6)
    y += 24

    # Source line
    rf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", REF_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Published in Nature Medicine  ·  July 2023", font=rf, fill=MUTED)
    y += 56

    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_CLR, 3)
    return y + 56


def render_metric_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, context, accent=None):
    """Dashboard card: bold value, label, muted context."""
    clr = accent if accent else STEEL

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=16,
        fill=CARD_BG, outline=CARD_EDGE, width=2,
    )

    # Accent bar
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x + 36, y + 36, x + 36 + 72, y + 44], radius=4, fill=clr)

    # Value
    vf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_VAL)
    vw, vh = text_size(draw, value, vf)
    draw.text((x + 36, y + 72), value, font=vf, fill=clr)

    # Label
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_LBL)
    lbl_lines = wrap_lines(draw, label, lf, w - 72)
    lbl_end = draw_text_block(draw, lbl_lines, x + 36, y + 72 + vh + 28, lf, BODY, ls=METRIC_LBL * 1.45)

    # Context
    ctf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", METRIC_CTX)
    ctx_lines = wrap_lines(draw, context, ctf, w - 72)
    draw_text_block(draw, ctx_lines, x + 36, lbl_end + 16, ctf, MUTED, ls=METRIC_CTX * 1.55)


def render_metrics_row(draw, y):
    """Four metric cards spanning full content width."""
    gap = 36
    card_w = (CW - 3 * gap) // 4
    card_h = 560

    cards = [
        (">90%", "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded the passing threshold on all three steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination"),
        ("500+", "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Over 500 peer-reviewed publications on LLMs in medicine published in 2023 alone"),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "Studies report LLMs generate fabricated medical references or inaccurate clinical information in up to 30% of outputs"),
        ("$10.5B", "Global LLM Health Market",
         "The healthcare LLM market is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030"),
    ]

    for i, (val, lbl, ctx) in enumerate(cards):
        cx = ML + i * (card_w + gap)
        accent = AMBER if i == 2 else None
        render_metric_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, lbl, ctx, accent)

    return y + card_h


def render_section_header(draw, x, y, w, title, number=None):
    """Numbered section header with rule beneath."""
    if number:
        # Filled circle with number
        r = 22
        nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 32)
        ns = str(number)
        nw, nh = text_size(draw, ns, nf)
        cx_c = x + r
        cy_c = y + 5 + r
        draw.ellipse([x, y + 5, x + r * 2, y + 5 + r * 2], fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((cx_c - nw // 2, cy_c - nh // 2), ns, font=nf, fill=WHITE)
        tx = x + r * 2 + 24
    else:
        tx = x

    hf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", SEC_SZ)
    draw.text((tx, y), title, font=hf, fill=NAVY)

        font=ff, fill=MUTED,

    # ── SAVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(OUTPUT, "PNG", optimize=True)
    mm_w = W / MM2PX

    print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Size: {W}×{H} px ({mm_w:.0f}×{mm_h:.0f} mm) at {DPI} DPI")
    # Report where the bottom content lands relative to canvas

    ]

    bar_area_w = w - 280
    row_h = 56
    label_x = x
    bar_x = x + 230
    cy = y + 20

    for model, score, clr in items:
        draw.text((label_x, cy + 4), model, font=lf, fill=BODY)

        val = float(score.replace(">", "").replace("~", "").replace("%", ""))
        bw = max(int((val / 100) * bar_area_w), 4)
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [bar_x, cy + 18, bar_x + bw, cy + 18 + 22],
            radius=5, fill=clr,
        )
        draw.text((bar_x + bw + 18, cy + 4), score, font=vf, fill=clr)
        cy += row_h

    return cy + 12


def render_risk_item(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Numbered risk item with coral accent circle."""
    nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_NUM)
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_TITLE)
    df = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", RISK_DESC)

    # Coral circle with number
    r = 19
    ns = str(number)
    nw, nh = text_size(draw, ns, nf)
    draw.ellipse([x, y + 3, x + r * 2, y + 3 + r * 2], fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((x + r - nw // 2, y + 3 + r - nh // 2), ns, font=nf, fill=WHITE)

    # Bold risk title
    draw.text((x + 56, y), title, font=tf, fill=NAVY)

    # Description
    desc_lines = wrap_lines(draw, description, df, w - 56)
    desc_y = y + RISK_TITLE + 14
    end_y = draw_text_block(draw, desc_lines, x + 56, desc_y, df, BODY, ls=RISK_DESC * 1.55)

    return end_y + 28


def render_framework_pillar(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Framework pillar: large teal number, title, muted description."""
    nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FW_NUM)
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FW_TITLE)
    df = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", FW_DESC)

    # Large number
    draw.text((x, y), str(number), font=nf, fill=TEAL)

    # Title (may have embedded newlines)
    tlines = title.split("\n")
    tend = draw_text_block(draw, tlines, x, y + FW_NUM + 12, tf, NAVY, ls=FW_TITLE * 1.4)

    # Description
    dlines = wrap_lines(draw, description, df, w)
    dend = draw_text_block(draw, dlines, x, tend + 12, df, MUTED, ls=FW_DESC * 1.55)

    return dend

def render():
    print(f"Rendering A0 poster: {W}×{H} px at {DPI} DPI…")
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── 1. TITLE BLOCK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y = render_title(draw)

    # ── 2. METRIC DASHBOARD CARDS ──────────────────────────────────────────
    y = render_metrics_row(draw, y)
    y += 56
    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_CLR, 2)
    y += 56

    # ── 3. TWO-COLUMN BODY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    col_start = y

    # ╔══ LEFT: Overview → Applications → Performance ══════════════════════╗
    ly = col_start

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "What Are LLMs and Why Do They Matter for Medicine?", number=1)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have rapidly entered the "
        "healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in understanding and generating medical "
        "text. Trained on vast corpora of text data, these foundation models are poised to reshape clinical "
        "practice, biomedical research, and medical education. The pace of adoption has been extraordinary, "
        "with the global healthcare LLM market projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
    )
    ly += 52

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Key Clinical and Research Applications", number=2)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "LLMs are being explored across a wide spectrum of medical tasks, from clinical documentation "
        "to biomedical research. Clinical documentation and patient-facing communication tools have seen "
        "the fastest real-world adoption, with several health systems already integrating LLM-powered "
        "assistants into electronic health records.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ly += 28
    ly = render_applications_table(draw, LX, ly, COL_W)
    ly += 52

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Performance Benchmarks and Evidence", number=3)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "LLM performance on standardized medical examinations has been a key evaluation domain. "
        "GPT-4 scored above 90% on all three steps of the USMLE, substantially exceeding the "
        "passing threshold of approximately 60%. Med-PaLM 2 achieved 86.5% on the MedQA benchmark, "
        "approaching expert physician-level performance. Earlier models such as GPT-3.5 scored near "
        "the passing threshold (~60%) but fell short on complex clinical reasoning. These results "
        "suggest that LLMs can encode substantial medical knowledge, though performance on real-world "
        "clinical scenarios remains less well characterized.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ly += 28
    ly = render_benchmark_bars(draw, LX, ly, COL_W)
    left_bottom = ly

    # ╔══ RIGHT: Risks — equal visual weight ═══════════════════════════════╗
    ry = col_start

    ry = render_section_header(draw, RX, ry, COL_W,
        "Risks, Limitations, and Ethical Concerns", number=4)
    ry = render_body(draw, RX, ry, COL_W,
        "Despite impressive benchmarks, significant concerns persist that must be "
        "acknowledged and addressed before widespread clinical deployment can be considered safe.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ry += 32

    risk_items = [
        ("Hallucinations and Fabrication",
         "LLMs can fabricate plausible-sounding but incorrect medical information, including fake "
         "citations and clinical guidelines. Studies report hallucination rates of up to 30% in "
         "medical question-answering tasks, making unverified outputs potentially dangerous in clinical settings."),
        ("Bias and Health Equity",
         "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities "
         "in care recommendations across demographic groups. Without systematic auditing, these "
         "biases could worsen existing healthcare inequities."),
        ("Patient Privacy and Data Governance",
         "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers operated by commercial "
         "entities, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns. The regulatory framework "
         "for LLM data handling in healthcare remains undeveloped."),
        ("Lack of Clinical Validation",
         "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical "
         "trials or real-world outcome studies. This evidence gap between exam scores and bedside "
         "safety is the central challenge facing the field."),
        ("Automation Bias and Over-Reliance",
         "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical "
         "appraisal. This risk is compounded by the models' tendency to present incorrect information "
         "with high confidence, creating a dangerous feedback loop."),
    ]

    for i, (rtitle, rdesc) in enumerate(risk_items, 1):
        ry = render_risk_item(draw, RX, ry, COL_W, i, rtitle, rdesc)

    right_bottom = ry
    col_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom)
    y = col_bottom + 64

    # ── 4. FRAMEWORK SECTION ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    band_top = y - 20

    # Draw the subtle background band first (content renders on top)
    band_h = 720
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [ML - 36, band_top, W - MR + 36, band_top + band_h],
        radius=24, fill=OFF_WHITE,
    )

    fy = band_top + 24
    fy = render_section_header(draw, ML, fy, CW,
        "A Framework for Responsible Deployment", number=5)
    fy = render_body(draw, ML, fy, CW,
        "The consensus from the Nature Medicine review is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential "
        "for medicine, but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust governance. "
        "The following five pillars constitute a multi-stakeholder framework for safe clinical integration.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    fy += 36

    # Five framework pillars
    pillar_gap = 48
    pillar_w = (CW - 4 * pillar_gap) // 5
    px = ML

    pillars = [
        ("Rigorous Prospective\nEvaluation",
         "Validate in diverse clinical settings using prospective trials, not retrospective benchmarks alone."),
        ("Human-in-the-Loop\nDesign",
         "Ensure clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs. AI augments, never replaces, clinical judgment."),
        ("Transparent\nReporting",
         "Disclose model limitations, training data sources, and known failure modes to all stakeholders."),
        ("Equity\nAudits",
         "Assess differential performance across patient populations to prevent widening healthcare disparities."),
        ("Regulatory\nAlignment",
         "Align with evolving FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices and clinical decision support."),
    ]

    pbottom = fy
    for i, (ptitle, pdesc) in enumerate(pillars, 1):
        end = render_framework_pillar(draw, px, fy, pillar_w, i, ptitle, pdesc)
        pbottom = max(pbottom, end)
        px += pillar_w + pillar_gap

    y = pbottom + 60

    # Final rule
    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, NAVY, 2)
    y += 40

    # ── 5. FOOTER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ff = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", FOOTER_SZ)
    draw.text(
        (ML, y),
        "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  ·  Nature Medicine, July 2023  ·  References available upon request",
        font=ff, fill=MUTED,
    )

    # ── SAVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(OUTPUT, "PNG", optimize=True)
    mm_w = W / MM2PX
    mm_h = H / MM2PX
    print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Size: {W}×{H} px ({mm_w:.0f}×{mm_h:.0f} mm) at {DPI} DPI")
    # Report where the bottom content lands relative to canvas
    pct = (y + 80) / H * 100
    print(f"Content ends at ~{pct:.0f}% of canvas height")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    render()

A0 portrait at 150 DPI: 4967 x 7022 px.
Design philosophy: Clinical Rationalism.

Refined typescale (physical → px at 150 DPI):
  Title: 72pt → 150px
  Section headers: 40pt → 83px
  Body: 23pt → 48px / 20pt → 42px
  Metric values: 58pt → 120px
  Small/caption: 16pt → 33px

Layout: poster mirrors a clinical research paper structure —
Introduction → Methods → Results → Adverse Events → Recommendations.
The amber risk metric functions like a flagged abnormal lab value.

CARD_EDGE  = (218, 224, 232)

# ── Grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 200, 200       # margins left/right
MT, MB = 200, 200       # margins top/bottom
CW      = W - ML - MR   # 4567
CH      = H - MT - MB   # 6622
COL_GAP = 80
COL_W   = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2  # 2243
LX      = ML
RX      = ML + COL_W + COL_GAP

# ── Type scale (px) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TITLE_SZ    = 150
SUB_SZ      = 44
SEC_SZ      = 83
BODY_SZ     = 48
BODY_SM     = 42
SMALL_SZ    = 34
METRIC_VAL  = 120
METRIC_LBL  = 36
METRIC_CTX  = 28
TAB_HDR     = 34
TAB_CELL    = 30

RISK_TITLE  = 40
RISK_DESC   = 34

FW_DESC     = 28

BENCH_VAL   = 40

# ── Font Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def text_size(draw, text, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0], b[3] - b[1]

def wrap_lines(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        trial = " ".join(cur + [w])
        if text_size(draw, trial, f)[0] <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur:
        lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def draw_text_block(draw, lines, x, y, f, fill, ls=None):
    if ls is None:
        ls = f.size * 1.5
    cy = y
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, cy), line, font=f, fill=fill)
        cy += ls
    return cy

def hrule(draw, x, y, w, color=RULE_CLR, thickness=2):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + thickness], fill=color)

def render_title(draw):
    """Conference name, title, subtitle, source reference."""
    y = MT

    # Subtle top accent line
    draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, y - 8, ML + 120, y - 2], radius=3, fill=STEEL)
    y += 20

    # Conference
    cf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", CONF_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024", font=cf, fill=MUTED)
    y += 56

    # Title — two balanced lines
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TITLE_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Large Language Models in Medicine:", font=tf, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SZ + 32
    draw.text((ML, y), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=tf, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SZ + 52

    # Subtitle
    sf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", SUB_SZ)
    sub = (
        "A comprehensive review of how large language models are transforming clinical practice, "
        "medical research, and healthcare delivery — along with the critical challenges that must be addressed."
    )
    sub_lines = wrap_lines(draw, sub, sf, CW - 60)
    y = draw_text_block(draw, sub_lines, ML, y, sf, MUTED, ls=SUB_SZ * 1.6)
    y += 24

    # Source line
    rf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", REF_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Published in Nature Medicine  ·  July 2023", font=rf, fill=MUTED)
    y += 56

    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_CLR, 3)
    return y + 56


def render_metric_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, context, accent=None):
    """Dashboard card: bold value, label, muted context."""
    clr = accent if accent else STEEL

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=16,
        fill=CARD_BG, outline=CARD_EDGE, width=2,
    )

    # Accent bar
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x + 36, y + 36, x + 36 + 72, y + 44], radius=4, fill=clr)

    # Value
    vf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_VAL)
    vw, vh = text_size(draw, value, vf)
    draw.text((x + 36, y + 72), value, font=vf, fill=clr)

    # Label
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_LBL)
    lbl_lines = wrap_lines(draw, label, lf, w - 72)
    lbl_end = draw_text_block(draw, lbl_lines, x + 36, y + 72 + vh + 28, lf, BODY, ls=METRIC_LBL * 1.45)

    # Context
    ctf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", METRIC_CTX)
    ctx_lines = wrap_lines(draw, context, ctf, w - 72)
    draw_text_block(draw, ctx_lines, x + 36, lbl_end + 16, ctf, MUTED, ls=METRIC_CTX * 1.55)


def render_metrics_row(draw, y):
    """Four metric cards spanning full content width."""
    gap = 36
    card_w = (CW - 3 * gap) // 4
    card_h = 560

    cards = [
        (">90%", "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded the passing threshold on all three steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination"),
        ("500+", "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Over 500 peer-reviewed publications on LLMs in medicine published in 2023 alone"),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "Studies report LLMs generate fabricated medical references or inaccurate clinical information in up to 30% of outputs"),
        ("$10.5B", "Global LLM Health Market",
         "The healthcare LLM market is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030"),
    ]

    for i, (val, lbl, ctx) in enumerate(cards):
        cx = ML + i * (card_w + gap)
        accent = AMBER if i == 2 else None
        render_metric_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, lbl, ctx, accent)

    return y + card_h


def render_section_header(draw, x, y, w, title, number=None):
    """Numbered section header with rule beneath."""
    if number:
        # Filled circle with number
        r = 22
        nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 32)
        ns = str(number)
        nw, nh = text_size(draw, ns, nf)
        cx_c = x + r
        cy_c = y + 5 + r
        draw.ellipse([x, y + 5, x + r * 2, y + 5 + r * 2], fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((cx_c - nw // 2, cy_c - nh // 2), ns, font=nf, fill=WHITE)
        tx = x + r * 2 + 24
    else:
        tx = x

    hf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", SEC_SZ)
    draw.text((tx, y), title, font=hf, fill=NAVY)

    _, th = text_size(draw, title, hf)
    ry = y + th + 22
    hrule(draw, x, ry, w, RULE_CLR, 2)
    return ry + 28


def render_body(draw, x, y, w, text, size=BODY_SZ):
    """Wrapped body paragraph."""
    bf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", size)
    lines = wrap_lines(draw, text, bf, w)
    return draw_text_block(draw, lines, x, y, bf, BODY, ls=size * 1.6)


def render_applications_table(draw, x, y, w):
    """Applications × maturity table with color-coded maturity column."""
    c1 = int(w * 0.37)
    c2 = int(w * 0.38)
    c3 = w - c1 - c2

    hf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TAB_HDR)
    cf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", TAB_CELL)
    pad = 20

    rows = [
        ("Clinical Documentation", "Automated notes, discharge summaries", "Pilot deployments"),
        ("Diagnostic Support", "Differential diagnosis, radiology reports", "Research stage"),
        ("Patient Communication", "Answering questions, simplifying jargon", "Early adoption"),
        ("Medical Education", "Exam prep, case-based learning, tutoring", "Active use"),
        ("Biomedical Research", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis gen.", "Emerging"),
    ]

    row_h = 74
    hdr_h = 60

    # Header row
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + hdr_h], fill=NAVY)
    draw.text((x + pad, y + 16), "Application Area", font=hf, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x + c1 + pad, y + 16), "Example Use Cases", font=hf, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x + c1 + c2 + pad, y + 16), "Maturity", font=hf, fill=WHITE)

    cy = y + hdr_h
    for i, (area, uses, mat) in enumerate(rows):
        bg = WHITE if i % 2 == 0 else OFF_WHITE
        draw.rectangle([x, cy, x + w, cy + row_h], fill=bg)
        hrule(draw, x, cy, w, RULE_CLR, 1)

        draw.text((x + pad, cy + 18), area, font=cf, fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((x + c1 + pad, cy + 18), uses, font=cf, fill=BODY)

        mc = MUTED
        if mat == "Active use":
            mc = TEAL
        elif mat == "Pilot deployments":
            mc = STEEL
        draw.text((x + c1 + c2 + pad, cy + 18), mat, font=cf, fill=mc)

        cy += row_h

    hrule(draw, x, cy, w, RULE_CLR, 1)
    return cy + 24


def render_benchmark_bars(draw, x, y, w):
    """Horizontal bar chart for model benchmark scores."""
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", BENCH_LBL)
    vf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", BENCH_VAL)

    items = [
        ("GPT-4", ">90%", STEEL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", "86.5%", TEAL),
        ("GPT-3.5", "~60%", MUTED),
        ("Passing Threshold", "60%", RULE_CLR),
    ]

    bar_area_w = w - 280
    row_h = 56
    label_x = x
    bar_x = x + 230
    cy = y + 20

    for model, score, clr in items:
        draw.text((label_x, cy + 4), model, font=lf, fill=BODY)

        val = float(score.replace(">", "").replace("~", "").replace("%", ""))
        bw = max(int((val / 100) * bar_area_w), 4)
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [bar_x, cy + 18, bar_x + bw, cy + 18 + 22],
            radius=5, fill=clr,
        )
        draw.text((bar_x + bw + 18, cy + 4), score, font=vf, fill=clr)
        cy += row_h

    return cy + 12


def render_risk_item(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Numbered risk item with coral accent circle."""
    nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_NUM)
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_TITLE)
    df = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", RISK_DESC)

    # Coral circle with number
    r = 19
    ns = str(number)
    nw, nh = text_size(draw, ns, nf)
    draw.ellipse([x, y + 3, x + r * 2, y + 3 + r * 2], fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((x + r - nw // 2, y + 3 + r - nh // 2), ns, font=nf, fill=WHITE)

    # Bold risk title
    draw.text((x + 56, y), title, font=tf, fill=NAVY)

    # Description
    desc_lines = wrap_lines(draw, description, df, w - 56)
    desc_y = y + RISK_TITLE + 14
    end_y = draw_text_block(draw, desc_lines, x + 56, desc_y, df, BODY, ls=RISK_DESC * 1.55)

    return end_y + 28


def render_framework_pillar(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Framework pillar: large teal number, title, muted description."""
    nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FW_NUM)
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FW_TITLE)
    df = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", FW_DESC)

    # Large number
    draw.text((x, y), str(number), font=nf, fill=TEAL)

    # Title (may have embedded newlines)
    tlines = title.split("\n")
    tend = draw_text_block(draw, tlines, x, y + FW_NUM + 12, tf, NAVY, ls=FW_TITLE * 1.4)

    # Description
    dlines = wrap_lines(draw, description, df, w)
    dend = draw_text_block(draw, dlines, x, tend + 12, df, MUTED, ls=FW_DESC * 1.55)

    return dend

def render():
    print(f"Rendering A0 poster: {W}×{H} px at {DPI} DPI…")
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── 1. TITLE BLOCK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y = render_title(draw)

    # ── 2. METRIC DASHBOARD CARDS ──────────────────────────────────────────
    y = render_metrics_row(draw, y)
    y += 56
    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_CLR, 2)
    y += 56

    # ── 3. TWO-COLUMN BODY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    col_start = y

    # ╔══ LEFT: Overview → Applications → Performance ══════════════════════╗
    ly = col_start

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "What Are LLMs and Why Do They Matter for Medicine?", number=1)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have rapidly entered the "
        "healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in understanding and generating medical "
        "text. Trained on vast corpora of text data, these foundation models are poised to reshape clinical "
        "practice, biomedical research, and medical education. The pace of adoption has been extraordinary, "
        "with the global healthcare LLM market projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
    )
    ly += 52

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Key Clinical and Research Applications", number=2)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "LLMs are being explored across a wide spectrum of medical tasks, from clinical documentation "
        "to biomedical research. Clinical documentation and patient-facing communication tools have seen "
        "the fastest real-world adoption, with several health systems already integrating LLM-powered "
        "assistants into electronic health records.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ly += 28
    ly = render_applications_table(draw, LX, ly, COL_W)
    ly += 52

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Performance Benchmarks and Evidence", number=3)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "LLM performance on standardized medical examinations has been a key evaluation domain. "
        "GPT-4 scored above 90% on all three steps of the USMLE, substantially exceeding the "
        "passing threshold of approximately 60%. Med-PaLM 2 achieved 86.5% on the MedQA benchmark, "
        "approaching expert physician-level performance. Earlier models such as GPT-3.5 scored near "
        "the passing threshold (~60%) but fell short on complex clinical reasoning. These results "
        "suggest that LLMs can encode substantial medical knowledge, though performance on real-world "
        "clinical scenarios remains less well characterized.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ly += 28
    ly = render_benchmark_bars(draw, LX, ly, COL_W)
    left_bottom = ly

    # ╔══ RIGHT: Risks — equal visual weight ═══════════════════════════════╗
    ry = col_start

    ry = render_section_header(draw, RX, ry, COL_W,
        "Risks, Limitations, and Ethical Concerns", number=4)
    ry = render_body(draw, RX, ry, COL_W,
        "Despite impressive benchmarks, significant concerns persist that must be "
        "acknowledged and addressed before widespread clinical deployment can be considered safe.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    ry += 32

    risk_items = [
        ("Hallucinations and Fabrication",
         "LLMs can fabricate plausible-sounding but incorrect medical information, including fake "
         "citations and clinical guidelines. Studies report hallucination rates of up to 30% in "
         "medical question-answering tasks, making unverified outputs potentially dangerous in clinical settings."),
        ("Bias and Health Equity",
         "Models may perpetuate or amplify biases present in training data, leading to disparities "
         "in care recommendations across demographic groups. Without systematic auditing, these "
         "biases could worsen existing healthcare inequities."),
        ("Patient Privacy and Data Governance",
         "Patient data used in prompts may be transmitted to external servers operated by commercial "
         "entities, raising serious HIPAA and GDPR compliance concerns. The regulatory framework "
         "for LLM data handling in healthcare remains undeveloped."),
        ("Lack of Clinical Validation",
         "Most LLM evaluations rely on multiple-choice benchmarks rather than prospective clinical "
         "trials or real-world outcome studies. This evidence gap between exam scores and bedside "
         "safety is the central challenge facing the field."),
        ("Automation Bias and Over-Reliance",
         "Clinicians may develop automation bias, accepting LLM outputs without sufficient critical "
         "appraisal. This risk is compounded by the models' tendency to present incorrect information "
         "with high confidence, creating a dangerous feedback loop."),
    ]

    for i, (rtitle, rdesc) in enumerate(risk_items, 1):
        ry = render_risk_item(draw, RX, ry, COL_W, i, rtitle, rdesc)

    right_bottom = ry
    col_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom)
    y = col_bottom + 64

    # ── 4. FRAMEWORK SECTION ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    band_top = y - 20

    # Draw the subtle background band first (content renders on top)
    band_h = 720
    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [ML - 36, band_top, W - MR + 36, band_top + band_h],
        radius=24, fill=OFF_WHITE,
    )

    fy = band_top + 24
    fy = render_section_header(draw, ML, fy, CW,
        "A Framework for Responsible Deployment", number=5)
    fy = render_body(draw, ML, fy, CW,
        "The consensus from the Nature Medicine review is clear: LLMs hold transformative potential "
        "for medicine, but their deployment must be guided by evidence, equity, and robust governance. "
        "The following five pillars constitute a multi-stakeholder framework for safe clinical integration.",
        size=BODY_SM,
    )
    fy += 36

    # Five framework pillars
    pillar_gap = 48
    pillar_w = (CW - 4 * pillar_gap) // 5
    px = ML

    pillars = [
        ("Rigorous Prospective\nEvaluation",
         "Validate in diverse clinical settings using prospective trials, not retrospective benchmarks alone."),
        ("Human-in-the-Loop\nDesign",
         "Ensure clinician oversight of all LLM-generated outputs. AI augments, never replaces, clinical judgment."),
        ("Transparent\nReporting",
         "Disclose model limitations, training data sources, and known failure modes to all stakeholders."),
        ("Equity\nAudits",
         "Assess differential performance across patient populations to prevent widening healthcare disparities."),
        ("Regulatory\nAlignment",
         "Align with evolving FDA, EMA, and WHO guidance on AI-based medical devices and clinical decision support."),
    ]

    pbottom = fy
    for i, (ptitle, pdesc) in enumerate(pillars, 1):
        end = render_framework_pillar(draw, px, fy, pillar_w, i, ptitle, pdesc)
        pbottom = max(pbottom, end)
        px += pillar_w + pillar_gap

    y = pbottom + 60

    # Final rule
    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, NAVY, 2)
    y += 40

    # ── 5. FOOTER ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    ff = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", FOOTER_SZ)
    draw.text(
        (ML, y),
        "Medical AI & Digital Health Conference 2024  ·  Nature Medicine, July 2023  ·  References available upon request",
        font=ff, fill=MUTED,
    )

    # ── SAVE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT), exist_ok=True)
    img.save(OUTPUT, "PNG", optimize=True)
    mm_w = W / MM2PX
    mm_h = H / MM2PX
    print(f"Saved: {OUTPUT}")
    print(f"Size: {W}×{H} px ({mm_w:.0f}×{mm_h:.0f} mm) at {DPI} DPI")
    # Report where the bottom content lands relative to canvas
    pct = (y + 80) / H * 100
    print(f"Content ends at ~{pct:.0f}% of canvas height")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    render()

"""Render the LLMs in Medicine academic poster.

A0 portrait at 150 DPI: 4967 x 7022 px.
Design philosophy: Clinical Rationalism.

Refined typescale (physical → px at 150 DPI):
  Title: 72pt → 150px
  Section headers: 40pt → 83px
  Body: 23pt → 48px / 20pt → 42px
  Metric values: 58pt → 120px
  Small/caption: 16pt → 33px

Layout: poster mirrors a clinical research paper structure —
Introduction → Methods → Results → Adverse Events → Recommendations.
The amber risk metric functions like a flagged abnormal lab value.
"""

import os, math
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

# ── Paths ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
OUTPUT   = "/app/output/final_poster.png"

# ── Canvas (A0 portrait, 150 DPI) ──────────────────────────────────────────
DPI     = 150
MM2PX   = DPI / 25.4
W       = round(841 * MM2PX)   # 4967
H       = round(1189 * MM2PX)  # 7022

# ── Palette: Clinical Rationalism ──────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = (10, 22, 40)
WHITE      = (255, 255, 255)
OFF_WHITE  = (246, 249, 252)
STEEL      = (74, 111, 165)
TEAL       = (44, 122, 140)
AMBER      = (212, 137, 42)
CORAL      = (224, 85, 74)
BODY       = (28, 28, 46)
MUTED      = (90, 106, 126)
RULE_CLR   = (208, 213, 221)
CARD_BG    = (245, 247, 250)
CARD_EDGE  = (218, 224, 232)

# ── Grid ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML, MR = 200, 200       # margins left/right
MT, MB = 200, 200       # margins top/bottom
CW      = W - ML - MR   # 4567
CH      = H - MT - MB   # 6622
COL_GAP = 80
COL_W   = (CW - COL_GAP) // 2  # 2243
LX      = ML
RX      = ML + COL_W + COL_GAP

# ── Type scale (px) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TITLE_SZ    = 150
SUB_SZ      = 44
SEC_SZ      = 83
BODY_SZ     = 48
BODY_SM     = 42
SMALL_SZ    = 34
METRIC_VAL  = 120
METRIC_LBL  = 36
METRIC_CTX  = 28
TAB_HDR     = 34
TAB_CELL    = 30
RISK_NUM    = 40
RISK_TITLE  = 40
RISK_DESC   = 34
FW_NUM      = 64
FW_TITLE    = 34
FW_DESC     = 28
BENCH_LBL   = 34
BENCH_VAL   = 40
CONF_SZ     = 34
FOOTER_SZ   = 28
REF_SZ      = 30

# ── Font Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)

def text_size(draw, text, f):
    b = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=f)
    return b[2] - b[0], b[3] - b[1]

def wrap_lines(draw, text, f, max_w):
    words = text.split()
    lines, cur = [], []
    for w in words:
        trial = " ".join(cur + [w])
        if text_size(draw, trial, f)[0] <= max_w:
            cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur:
                lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur:
        lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def draw_text_block(draw, lines, x, y, f, fill, ls=None):
    if ls is None:
        ls = f.size * 1.5
    cy = y
    for line in lines:
        draw.text((x, cy), line, font=f, fill=fill)
        cy += ls
    return cy

def hrule(draw, x, y, w, color=RULE_CLR, thickness=2):
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + thickness], fill=color)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMPONENTS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render_title(draw):
    """Conference name, title, subtitle, source reference."""
    y = MT

    # Subtle top accent line
    draw.rounded_rectangle([ML, y - 8, ML + 120, y - 2], radius=3, fill=STEEL)
    y += 20

    # Conference
    cf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", CONF_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "MEDICAL AI & DIGITAL HEALTH CONFERENCE 2024", font=cf, fill=MUTED)
    y += 56

    # Title — two balanced lines
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TITLE_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Large Language Models in Medicine:", font=tf, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SZ + 32
    draw.text((ML, y), "Opportunities, Risks, and the Path Forward", font=tf, fill=NAVY)
    y += TITLE_SZ + 52

    # Subtitle
    sf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", SUB_SZ)
    sub = (
        "A comprehensive review of how large language models are transforming clinical practice, "
        "medical research, and healthcare delivery — along with the critical challenges that must be addressed."
    )
    sub_lines = wrap_lines(draw, sub, sf, CW - 60)
    y = draw_text_block(draw, sub_lines, ML, y, sf, MUTED, ls=SUB_SZ * 1.6)
    y += 24

    # Source line
    rf = font("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", REF_SZ)
    draw.text((ML, y), "Published in Nature Medicine  ·  July 2023", font=rf, fill=MUTED)
    y += 56

    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_CLR, 3)
    return y + 56


def render_metric_card(draw, x, y, w, h, value, label, context, accent=None):
    """Dashboard card: bold value, label, muted context."""
    clr = accent if accent else STEEL

    draw.rounded_rectangle(
        [x, y, x + w, y + h], radius=16,
        fill=CARD_BG, outline=CARD_EDGE, width=2,
    )

    # Accent bar
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x + 36, y + 36, x + 36 + 72, y + 44], radius=4, fill=clr)

    # Value
    vf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_VAL)
    vw, vh = text_size(draw, value, vf)
    draw.text((x + 36, y + 72), value, font=vf, fill=clr)

    # Label
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", METRIC_LBL)
    lbl_lines = wrap_lines(draw, label, lf, w - 72)
    lbl_end = draw_text_block(draw, lbl_lines, x + 36, y + 72 + vh + 28, lf, BODY, ls=METRIC_LBL * 1.45)

    # Context
    ctf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", METRIC_CTX)
    ctx_lines = wrap_lines(draw, context, ctf, w - 72)
    draw_text_block(draw, ctx_lines, x + 36, lbl_end + 16, ctf, MUTED, ls=METRIC_CTX * 1.55)


def render_metrics_row(draw, y):
    """Four metric cards spanning full content width."""
    gap = 36
    card_w = (CW - 3 * gap) // 4
    card_h = 560

    cards = [
        (">90%", "GPT-4 USMLE Score",
         "Exceeded the passing threshold on all three steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination"),
        ("500+", "PubMed Articles (2023)",
         "Over 500 peer-reviewed publications on LLMs in medicine published in 2023 alone"),
        ("Up to 30%", "Hallucination Rate",
         "Studies report LLMs generate fabricated medical references or inaccurate clinical information in up to 30% of outputs"),
        ("$10.5B", "Global LLM Health Market",
         "The healthcare LLM market is projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030"),
    ]

    for i, (val, lbl, ctx) in enumerate(cards):
        cx = ML + i * (card_w + gap)
        accent = AMBER if i == 2 else None
        render_metric_card(draw, cx, y, card_w, card_h, val, lbl, ctx, accent)

    return y + card_h


def render_section_header(draw, x, y, w, title, number=None):
    """Numbered section header with rule beneath."""
    if number:
        # Filled circle with number
        r = 22
        nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", 32)
        ns = str(number)
        nw, nh = text_size(draw, ns, nf)
        cx_c = x + r
        cy_c = y + 5 + r
        draw.ellipse([x, y + 5, x + r * 2, y + 5 + r * 2], fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((cx_c - nw // 2, cy_c - nh // 2), ns, font=nf, fill=WHITE)
        tx = x + r * 2 + 24
    else:
        tx = x

    hf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", SEC_SZ)
    draw.text((tx, y), title, font=hf, fill=NAVY)

    _, th = text_size(draw, title, hf)
    ry = y + th + 22
    hrule(draw, x, ry, w, RULE_CLR, 2)
    return ry + 28


def render_body(draw, x, y, w, text, size=BODY_SZ):
    """Wrapped body paragraph."""
    bf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", size)
    lines = wrap_lines(draw, text, bf, w)
    return draw_text_block(draw, lines, x, y, bf, BODY, ls=size * 1.6)


def render_applications_table(draw, x, y, w):
    """Applications × maturity table with color-coded maturity column."""
    c1 = int(w * 0.37)
    c2 = int(w * 0.38)
    c3 = w - c1 - c2

    hf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", TAB_HDR)
    cf = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", TAB_CELL)
    pad = 20

    rows = [
        ("Clinical Documentation", "Automated notes, discharge summaries", "Pilot deployments"),
        ("Diagnostic Support", "Differential diagnosis, radiology reports", "Research stage"),
        ("Patient Communication", "Answering questions, simplifying jargon", "Early adoption"),
        ("Medical Education", "Exam prep, case-based learning, tutoring", "Active use"),
        ("Biomedical Research", "Literature synthesis, hypothesis gen.", "Emerging"),
    ]

    row_h = 74
    hdr_h = 60

    # Header row
    draw.rectangle([x, y, x + w, y + hdr_h], fill=NAVY)
    draw.text((x + pad, y + 16), "Application Area", font=hf, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x + c1 + pad, y + 16), "Example Use Cases", font=hf, fill=WHITE)
    draw.text((x + c1 + c2 + pad, y + 16), "Maturity", font=hf, fill=WHITE)

    cy = y + hdr_h
    for i, (area, uses, mat) in enumerate(rows):
        bg = WHITE if i % 2 == 0 else OFF_WHITE
        draw.rectangle([x, cy, x + w, cy + row_h], fill=bg)
        hrule(draw, x, cy, w, RULE_CLR, 1)

        draw.text((x + pad, cy + 18), area, font=cf, fill=NAVY)
        draw.text((x + c1 + pad, cy + 18), uses, font=cf, fill=BODY)

        mc = MUTED
        if mat == "Active use":
            mc = TEAL
        elif mat == "Pilot deployments":
            mc = STEEL
        draw.text((x + c1 + c2 + pad, cy + 18), mat, font=cf, fill=mc)

        cy += row_h

    hrule(draw, x, cy, w, RULE_CLR, 1)
    return cy + 24


def render_benchmark_bars(draw, x, y, w):
    """Horizontal bar chart for model benchmark scores."""
    lf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", BENCH_LBL)
    vf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", BENCH_VAL)

    items = [
        ("GPT-4", ">90%", STEEL),
        ("Med-PaLM 2", "86.5%", TEAL),
        ("GPT-3.5", "~60%", MUTED),
        ("Passing Threshold", "60%", RULE_CLR),
    ]

    bar_area_w = w - 280
    row_h = 56
    label_x = x
    bar_x = x + 230
    cy = y + 20

    for model, score, clr in items:
        draw.text((label_x, cy + 4), model, font=lf, fill=BODY)

        val = float(score.replace(">", "").replace("~", "").replace("%", ""))
        bw = max(int((val / 100) * bar_area_w), 4)
        draw.rounded_rectangle(
            [bar_x, cy + 18, bar_x + bw, cy + 18 + 22],
            radius=5, fill=clr,
        )
        draw.text((bar_x + bw + 18, cy + 4), score, font=vf, fill=clr)
        cy += row_h

    return cy + 12


def render_risk_item(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Numbered risk item with coral accent circle."""
    nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_NUM)
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", RISK_TITLE)
    df = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", RISK_DESC)

    # Coral circle with number
    r = 19
    ns = str(number)
    nw, nh = text_size(draw, ns, nf)
    draw.ellipse([x, y + 3, x + r * 2, y + 3 + r * 2], fill=CORAL)
    draw.text((x + r - nw // 2, y + 3 + r - nh // 2), ns, font=nf, fill=WHITE)

    # Bold risk title
    draw.text((x + 56, y), title, font=tf, fill=NAVY)

    # Description
    desc_lines = wrap_lines(draw, description, df, w - 56)
    desc_y = y + RISK_TITLE + 14
    end_y = draw_text_block(draw, desc_lines, x + 56, desc_y, df, BODY, ls=RISK_DESC * 1.55)

    return end_y + 28


def render_framework_pillar(draw, x, y, w, number, title, description):
    """Framework pillar: large teal number, title, muted description."""
    nf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FW_NUM)
    tf = font("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf", FW_TITLE)
    df = font("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", FW_DESC)

    # Large number
    draw.text((x, y), str(number), font=nf, fill=TEAL)

    # Title (may have embedded newlines)
    tlines = title.split("\n")
    tend = draw_text_block(draw, tlines, x, y + FW_NUM + 12, tf, NAVY, ls=FW_TITLE * 1.4)

    # Description
    dlines = wrap_lines(draw, description, df, w)
    dend = draw_text_block(draw, dlines, x, tend + 12, df, MUTED, ls=FW_DESC * 1.55)

    return dend


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MAIN RENDER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def render():
    print(f"Rendering A0 poster: {W}×{H} px at {DPI} DPI…")
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), WHITE)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # ── 1. TITLE BLOCK ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y = render_title(draw)

    # ── 2. METRIC DASHBOARD CARDS ──────────────────────────────────────────
    y = render_metrics_row(draw, y)
    y += 56
    hrule(draw, ML, y, CW, RULE_CLR, 2)
    y += 56

    # ── 3. TWO-COLUMN BODY ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    col_start = y

    # ╔══ LEFT: Overview → Applications → Performance ══════════════════════╗
    ly = col_start

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "What Are LLMs and Why Do They Matter for Medicine?", number=1)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-4, Med-PaLM 2, and LLaMA have rapidly entered the "
        "healthcare landscape, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in understanding and generating medical "
        "text. Trained on vast corpora of text data, these foundation models are poised to reshape clinical "
        "practice, biomedical research, and medical education. The pace of adoption has been extraordinary, "
        "with the global healthcare LLM market projected to reach $10.5 billion by 2030."
    )
    ly += 52

    ly = render_section_header(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
        "Key Clinical and Research Applications", number=2)
    ly = render_body(draw, LX, ly, COL_W,
